description: Source code implementing RSA padding and encryption/decryption functions in OpenSSL's BoringSSL library, including PKCS1_OAEP and PKCS1_type_2 padding schemes.

methods.name: rand_nonzero
methods.description: Generates random non-zero bytes using RAND_bytes.

methods.name: RSA_padding_add_PKCS1_OAEP_mgf1
methods.description: Adds OAEP padding with MG1 mask generation function to data.

methods.name: RSA_padding_check_PKCS1_OAEP_mgf1
methods.description: Checks and removes OAEP padding with MG1 mask generation function from data.

methods.name: rsa_padding_add_PKCS1_type_2
methods.description: Adds PKCS#1 v1.5 padding type 2 to data.

methods.name: rsa_padding_check_PKCS1_type_2
methods.description: Checks and removes PKCS#1 v1.5 padding type 2 from data.

methods.name: RSA_public_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data with RSA public key.

methods.name: RSA_private_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data with RSA private key.

methods.name: RSA_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts RSA data with padding, using method if available.

methods.name: RSA_private_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts RSA data with private key.

methods.name: RSA_public_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts RSA data with public key.
